categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: Food (sugar and processed products), Livestock Distribution (pork, beef, poultry), Feed (compound feed), and Others (golf courses, group catering). The Food segment accounts for 48.8% of sales, Livestock Distribution 27.0%, Feed 20.0%, and Others 4.2%. Subsidiaries contribute to feed production and golf course operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on manufacturing technologies for sugar refining and compound feed production, with production facilities in Incheon and Ulsan. It uses forward contracts to manage raw material price volatility and maintains high production utilization rates (94.5% for food, 88.7% for feed). The company also invests in machinery upgrades to enhance production capacity and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international food demanders, livestock farmers, distributors, and retail chains. The Food segment serves end consumers and large retailers domestically and in Asia. The Livestock Distribution segment supplies import meat to domestic distributors and end users. The Feed segment sells mainly to livestock farms and agricultural cooperatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in South Korea with significant export sales to Asian countries. The company has domestic production sites in Incheon and Ulsan and overseas subsidiaries in China. Export sales mainly involve sugar and feed products to Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain, producing refined sugar and compound feed, distributing imported meat products, and providing related services such as catering and golf course management. It sources raw materials like raw sugar and grains internationally and sells finished products to end users and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core business competitiveness through selection and concentration, innovation, and new product development. R&D focuses on functional sugars with health benefits, low-calorie sweeteners, and customized feed products. The company invests in production technology upgrades and pursues partnerships with advanced livestock countries for feed technology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of sugar, processed food products, imported meat, and compound feed. Additional income comes from service operations such as golf course management and group catering. Sales are made via direct sales, distributors, and export channels with credit and trade finance arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a 21.6% market share in the sugar industry, competing with other sugar producers. In the feed segment, it has a smaller market share (~1.8%), indicating a competitive market dominated by larger players. The company positions itself as a stable supplier with diversified business lines and focuses on expanding market share through innovation and partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated sales of approximately 1.33 trillion KRW in 2023 with a net profit of 32.5 billion KRW, showing a 27.4% increase in net income year-over-year. Total assets are about 1.18 trillion KRW with a stable capital structure (debt ratio 114%, current ratio 192%). The company maintains steady growth despite global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product safety, quality, and health functionality, especially in its sugar products with patented functional sweeteners. It differentiates through stable supply partnerships in livestock distribution and customized, high-quality feed products. Its diversified portfolio including services like golf courses and catering adds resilience and customer value.
